title: The Stock Market Is About to Make a BIG Move
creator: Mark Roussin CPA
summary: Mark Roussin CPA argues the market may be setting up for a big move: fear is at 23 (extreme fear), midterms are weeks away and the S&P 500 has returned positively in the 12 months after every midterm since 1950 (about +15% on average), tech has pulled back 10-20% while earnings and cash flow still climb, and a possible end to the Iran war could lower oil, inflation and Fed hike pressure (three hikes are priced by end-2027; he expects fewer). He is selective — backlog and real AI earnings over borrowed-money build-outs — naming Nvidia, Broadcom, AMD and Marvell as producing real earnings today and CoreWeave and Oracle as not high-quality and not in his portfolio. No explicit buy, hold or sell call, price or target for any ticker, so all six are logged UNCERTAIN and the video does not alert on its own.
